verdict.rationale: Linear's homepage says it can automatically turn conversations and customer feedback into issues that are instantly routed, labeled, and prioritized for the right team. Linear Agent can also pick up newly reported issues to investigate and attempt a fix, event-triggered Loops cover recurring agent work, and triage is named as an in-Linear agent workflow. Missing for 10: in-depth first-party documentation of how AI triage and prioritization works and how to configure it (the evidence is marketing and changelog lines), and independent or hands-on corroboration that it works.
